bibl.title: Reconsidering the Metamorphosis of Io: on Texts, Images and Dates.
bibl.seg: Ariadne Konstantinou, Reconsidering the Metamorphosis of Io: on Texts, Images and Dates.
bibl.note: The comparison between the texts (in part. Bacchylides' Ode 19) and images may rather draw attention to the fact that there is synchronic variation in the ways whereby extant sources from the years around the mid-fifth century choose to depict Io. There was probably no standard depiction of the myth at the time. This suggests that myth interpretation may be revitalized by a paradigm shift from "tree" to "network".
